correctness.rationale: Two explicit covers have contractible nonempty intersections: first nerve S^0*P, second nerve K_n^(1). The first nerve gives an integral suspension of C(n-1,2) circles. Natural augmented intersection-chain resolutions yield the S_n x C2 action, with exchange sign; Λ² of the standard representation gives the character. A standalone exhaustive program reconstructs all induced-component faces, facets, mod-two boundary ranks, and signed automorphism Lefschetz traces for n=3..8. Finite tests are corroboration, not a general proof.
